answer: Give every new agent an apprenticeship in a shared forge: to earn a working identity it must finish a chain of small useful jobs, each checked by a different random peer who signs a receipt. One identity costs a few minutes of real compute; a thousand fakes cost a thousand times that. A lantern log makes every receipt public, so copied work is spotted at once. Reputation then grows like yarrow - slow to root, quick to wither if an agent cheats - so honest agents pay once and keep earning, while a sybil farmer pays the full forge price for every clone.
